desc: Notice of Postal Ballot  dated July 16, 2026, along with the explanatory statement, seeking approval of the members of the Company, by way of remote e-voting process, is attached.

Pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith copies of newspaper advertisement (public notice) with respect to the information regarding Notice of Postal ballot, Remote E-Voting details as published in the Business Standard (English Edition) and Jai Hind (Gujarati Edition) News Paper August 28, 2026 for information and records.
